summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 30, 2026, announcing the scheduling of its third quarter 2026 financial results, to be released after market close on October 28, 2026, with a conference call the following morning at 10:00 am ET. The release provides dial-in numbers, webcast registration details, and replay access through November 28, 2026, along with a standard company overview. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is involved; this is a routine earnings-notice filing with no special-situation element or risk-arb angle.
